title.narrative: Strengthening quality and effectiveness of hum response through capacity building (Cost reimbursment

description.narrative: This project is aimed at beginning to redress this imbalance, by strengthening the capacity of local and national organizations and networks working directly with communities affected by natural disasters, conflict, and protracted crises. Adeso is in the process of establishing a functional global network of local and national organizations, with the aim of creating a people centred and locally driven humanitarian response. The proposed project will focus on strengthening organizational capacity and enhancing access to direct funding for members of this nascent network. Targeted organisations in 5 countries (DRC, Somalia, South Sudan, Turkey and Nepal) will be supported to assess their capacity gaps and needs, using locally appropriate tools and methodologies. Research into existing pooled funding mechanisms such as the START Financial Enablers project led by Oxfam, UN pooled funds, the Global Fund for Aids, and multi-donor trust funds will be undertaken and based on extensive consultations. A pilot pooled funding mechanism for local and national NGOs will be designed and be ready to be trialed by the end of the project. Being situated within Adeso's wider 5-year network development project, this project will build on and link to a broad spectrum of work on developing SNGOs' humanitarian capacity and is expected to significantly contribute to a more inclusive, more effective and more responsive humanitarian system globally.
